data.body: DD4 SCOPE EXPANSION (loop, 2026-06-05): the allowlist tightening propagates wider than DD4's original test list. Full re-baseline now includes (beyond the 5 originally enumerated): test-two-layer-review-gate.sh (docs-only commit blocked by Layer 1 pre-commit gate, exit 1; fixed via bug f1ce), test-check-allowlist-correctness.sh (docs/** in an allowlist now REJECTED by the _INSTRUCTION_PROBES set), test-harvest-worktree.sh #24/#25 (docs-only commit now REQUIRES review-status -> harvest exits 2 + does NOT merge; the harvest/merge path also stops skipping review for docs — the d591-b6ad docs-skip is superseded). This is DD1's intended effect (an un-reviewed instruction surface must not ride to main via ANY path: pre-commit gate, harvest, or CI), NOT a plan deviation. Consolidated on clean branch story/588e-abec-221f-42c0/3783-allowlist-v3 @8fc707899b off main; orphaned PRs #651/#653 + their staged branches are dead-ends. All CI-flagged Hook+Script test failures resolved locally.
